meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会通过 lsp 工具调用语言服务器,可查看某个文件或目录的诊断报错、定位符号定义、查找符号引用、列出符号,并在重命名前检查是否安全。配置放在 .codex/lsp-client.json。
howto.when: 当你在当前工作区需要语言服务器诊断、定义跳转、引用查找等能力时接管;若诊断提示缺少语言服务器,先查状态。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude calls language-server tools through the lsp MCP interface: diagnostics for a file or directory, go-to-definition, find-references, symbol listing, and rename validity checks in the current workspace. Config lives in .codex/lsp-client.json.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you need language-server diagnostics, go-to-definition, find-references, or similar checks in the current workspace; if a language server is reported missing, check status first.
